summary: Complete testing of achievement badges system, unified wallet connector, and combined Journal+Portfolio UI. All 24 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all 6 tabs (Dashboard, Trades, Portfolio, Achievements, Import, Backup), unified wallet modal showing Solana and EVM options, and price ticker displaying ETH/SOL prices.

GET /api/achievements/badges - response has correct categories array
GET /api/achievements/user/{address} - has wallet_address, stats, badges, total_badges, available_badges
GET /api/achievements/user/{address} - stats has all required fields
GET /api/achievements/share-data/{address} - has wallet_address, stats, best_badge, share_text
GET /api/achievements/share-data/{address} - stats has win_streak, best_streak, win_rate, total_pnl, total_trades
GET /api/achievements/community/benchmarks - has total_users, total_trades, average_win_rate, average_streak, top_streaks
GET /api/achievements/community/benchmarks - works with wallet_address parameter for percentile calculation
POST /api/achievements/opt-in - returns success and opt_in fields
GET /api/achievements/leaderboard - has leaderboard array and total_participants
GET /api/achievements/leaderboard - sort_by parameter works (streak, win_rate, pnl, trades)
